A1.justification: Both complete 26-page PDFs describe FieryGS. Their text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–C are readable and reliably matchable despite repagination.

before.justification: v1 reports original fire-synthesis evaluations on six scenes, two user studies, material-reasoning accuracy, and runtime measurements (Section 4 and Appendix B).

after.justification: v2 retains the original scene evaluations, user studies, material-reasoning accuracy, and runtime measurements reported in v1.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Appendix A retain the same reconstruction and segmentation pipeline, GPT-4o material reasoning, combustion and charring simulation, unified renderer, and optional Wan2.1 refinement.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same six scenes: Firewood, Kitchen, Chair, Stool, Garden from MipNeRF360, and Playground from Tanks and Temples. The combustion and user-control scenarios are unchanged.

E2.justification: AutoVFX, Runway-V2V, and Instruct-GS2GS remain the comparison methods in Section 4 and Appendix B. No comparator is added, removed, or replaced within the corresponding evaluations.

E3.justification: The metrics, scene configurations, baseline prompts, and evaluation procedures are unchanged. Both user studies retain 86 and 88 participants respectively, 31 randomly sampled image/video pairs, and randomized left–right presentation.

E4.justification: The user-control analysis in Figure 7, material-reasoning error analysis in Appendix B.3, and generative-refinement consistency analysis in Appendix B.6 and Figure 11 are retained without changes.

E5.justification: Both versions use the same point estimates and user-preference percentages. Neither introduces repeated-run or seed information, confidence intervals, significance tests, or other uncertainty-estimation procedures.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 2–6 and the qualitative result images are unchanged. For example, FieryGS retains Table 2 scores of 0.624, 0.702, and 0.38, and Table 5 retains mean material accuracy of 89.31%.

T1.justification: Equations 1–11 and their associated definitions, modeling assumptions, and mathematical explanations remain unchanged in Section 3 and Appendix A. Equation relocation reflects pagination only.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same novelty, automation, physical-plausibility, controllability, and comparative-performance claims. No contribution is added, strengthened, or narrowed.

C2.justification: The interpretations and limitations remain unchanged, including omitted material degradation and mass loss, restricted scene scale, reconstruction and material-classification errors, and consistency problems from generative refinement.

D1.justification: Appendices A and B preserve the same prompts, hyperparameters, simulation grid, rendering samples, software, hardware, and runtime details. The project link and statement that code and data will be released upon acceptance are also unchanged.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, cited works, bibliography content, and positioning relative to prior simulation and neural-scene methods are unchanged. Bibliography pagination changes only.

P1.justification: v2 consolidates six affiliation entries into Peking University and ByteDance Seed, removes the Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence affiliation, and deletes the Beijing Science and Technology Program funding acknowledgement. Scientific prose and section order remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The shorter affiliation block and spacing changes reflow the main text and references: the introduction starts on page 1 instead of page 2, and Section 5 starts on page 8 instead of page 10. Figure and table content, captions, and appendix layouts remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 changes affiliations, removes the funding acknowledgement, and adjusts pagination, while retaining the scientific text, methods, evidence, reproducibility details, and appendices. These limited administrative and layout edits do not resolve a substantive deficiency or materially change the paper's overall quality.
